text:
Ava (Marketing): Quick sync — SlateCase just signed off to be our Q2 spotlight. Need to lock interview time, quote approvals, and legal signoff. Also planning launch post + webinar mention. Rough timeline?
Liam (PMM): Amazing — recommend we lead with the latency + cost narrative. I'll draft the quote ask (short, metric-first).
Marco (CSM): Customer is ok with a case study; they want to review any quote before publish. They can do a 30m interview Mon/Tue next week.
Chen (Content): I'll own transcript and soundbites. Can someone confirm the benchmark numbers we can publish? Don't want to overpromise.
Rina (Legal): Heads-up — we need a signed opt-in and the standard quote waiver. Also: if we cite benchmark numbers, send the supporting data to legal@redwood for review.
Ava (Marketing): Sending draft questions now. @Nate (Sales) — after webinar, route inbound leads to AE queue ‘Dedicated-Q2’?
Nate (Sales): Yes. Set webhook to CRM and tag leads with "SlateCase-Spotlight". Also define MQL criteria (attended 50%+, company size). I'll follow up.
Chen (Content): Draft interview questions pasted below for quick review — please flag edits:```
1) What was your baseline throughput/latency before Redwood?
2) What changes did you make to prompts or infra during rollout?
3) Can you quantify cost/perf improvements (pct or x-fold)?
4) Any internal story we can quote about developer/operator experience?
5) Any usage guidance for teams attempting similar rollouts?
```
Marco (CSM): Sending invite — stakeholder review call Thu 2pm so we can walk through the draft quote before legal. Invite sent to Ava, Chen, Olga, Marco.
calendar-bot: Event created: "SlateCase case study interview" Thu 14:00 - attendees: Ava, Marco, Chen, Olga, Rina (optional).
Rina (Legal): I will review the quote wording after Marco adds it to the doc. If they push on absolute numbers, we can include a parenthetical: "based on internal tests during YYYY-MM" and a link to the supporting perf snapshot.
Ava (Marketing): Proposed timeline: interview Thu, legal signoff by Fri, assets ready next Wed, publish + webinar shout two weeks after publish. Sound realistic?
Liam (PMM): That works. For the benchmark narrative: include A/B test setup, sample prompts, and the dataset shape (seq len distribution) — I'll pull notes from Eng.
Chen (Content): Asset checklist: final quote (one-liner), hero stat (e.g., 4x latency improvement), 3 screenshots (dashboard, latency graph, quote overlay), raw transcript, 3 curated soundbites. I'll prep a press-ready draft once quote locked.
Nate (Sales): Lead routing plan: after webinar, export attendance, tag high-intent folks as "webinar-high" and send CSV to Sales Ops. I'll create the automation rule.
Olga (SlateCase): Thanks all — confirm Thu 2pm is good for us. I'll share a private spreadsheet with internal metrics for Marco to review before the interview.
Ava (Marketing): Perfect. I'll post the draft announcement by EOD for review (PMM + Legal). @Rina please flag any hard no's early.
Chen (Content): :thumbsup: Adding checklist to the shared drive and will drop links once assets are uploaded.
Rina (Legal): Quick note — if we use a customer logo, ensure trademark usage is in the opt-in. If they want an embargo, add the date to the doc.
Marco (CSM): Noted. Olga — any embargo preferences?
Olga (SlateCase): We prefer a one-week embargo after internal review. Will confirm in the invite thread.
Ava (Marketing): Ok locking that in. Thanks team — will follow up with the draft quote + announcement URL.
Chen (Content): Will prep teaser lines for social + webinar blurb once quote is final.
Liam (PMM): I'll coordinate with Eng to extract perf logs for legal backup and the benchmark appendix.
Ava (Marketing): Great — closing loop: interview Thu, legal by Fri, assets next Wed, publish + webinar mention two weeks later. If anything slips, call it out in this thread.
